module: Complete and defend the release record

lesson.title: Choose the public, restricted or national record
lesson.summary: Select the correct database destination and the separate public-deployer duty.

prerequisites.reason: The destination lookup starts with the applicable actor/system registration duty. The deployer record is distinct from the provider registration duty.

blocks: A **public-deployer registration** is separate from the provider entry. Public authorities, Union institutions/bodies/offices/agencies, and persons acting on their behalf register themselves, select the system and register its use before use or putting into service an Annex III high-risk system other than point 2. Ordinary private deployers are not all covered by this particular duty.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 49(3)–(5); Article 71; Annex VIII Section C

blocks: Annex VIII Section C records deployer and submitter identities; the provider's database entry URL; a summary of the Article 27 fundamental-rights impact assessment; and, where applicable, the data-protection impact assessment summary. Check the applicability and actual assessment evidence. Registration does not replace either assessment or the provider's entry.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 49(3)–(5); Article 71; Annex VIII Section C

blocks: The **registration destination test** distinguishes the ordinary EU record from a secure non-public section. For Annex III points 1, 6 and 7 in law-enforcement, migration, asylum or border-control contexts, the specified reduced fields go in the secure section, accessible only to the Commission and relevant Article 74(8) national authorities. Neither all biometric records nor all public-sector records are automatically restricted.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 49(3)–(5); Article 71; Annex VIII Section C

blocks: Article 49(4) specifies Section A points 1–10 excluding 6, 8 and 9; Section B points 1–5 and 8–9; Section C points 1–3; and specified Annex IX real-world-test fields. The Annex IX reference is a lookup boundary, not a complete real-world-testing course. Its Section B9 reference persists despite B9's deletion in this baseline: flag interpretation and verify current instructions, rather than invent the deleted field.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 49(3)–(5); Article 71; Annex VIII Section C

blocks: Annex III point 2 critical-infrastructure systems use registration at national level under Article 49(5). Verify the actual national authority, portal and required process for the country; this lesson has not checked individual national portals. For each release/use, record actor, system, context, destination, date and receipt. A provider's public entry cannot prove a public customer's separate use entry.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 49(3)–(5); Article 71; Annex VIII Section C
